runs.name: SiteOne Landscape Supply, Inc.
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$87.99** (close 2026-10-12, `tools/run.py` live quote, aggregator, flagged). Shares **43,655,390**, one class (10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-28, acc 0001650729-26-000016, `Screens/cover_shares.py`; issued less treasury 43,754,262 at 2026-06-28 less 100,692 bought in July gives 43,653,570, within 1,820 shares); cap **$3,841.2M**. Sovereign **5.60%** (USD; Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-09). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (acc 0001650729-26-000005), the 10-Q above, DEF 14A (0001104659-26-038879), the 2026 8-Ks, the 10-Ks FY2018 to FY2024, the 424B5 of 2020-08-05. One figure cross-checked: FY2025 operating cash $300.5M on the filed cash-flow statement, equal to the XBRL value. `tools/run.py`'s D&A column is intangible amortization only (its own warning), set aside; the delivery fleet held on finance leases charged in owner cash (CONVENTION of this run: assets obtained on the all-equity basis, principal repaid on the equity-only basis). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Competitors: nine rivals named in the 10-K, seven private; Heritage and Horizon file only through parents (Home Depot, Pool Corporation) that do not report their landscape lines, read as indicative only. **Q1 IN**: a branch distributor of landscape supplies to about 440,000 contractors, sales about 36% maintenance, 34% new construction, 30% repair and upgrade. **Q2 OUT**: barriers to entry "generally low" in the filer's own Item 1A (FY2018 and FY2025 alike); the money test answered yes by its own roll-up ($796.9M paid for businesses FY2021 to FY2025, local and regional rivals still 81% of the market) and Home Depot's 2024 purchase of SRS, owner of Heritage; prices follow commodity costs both ways (price about 18% of FY2022 sales growth, minus 3% in FY2024); cost to serve 26.8% to 29.7% of sales while sales nearly tripled; operating margin 4.5% FY2016, 9.0% FY2021, 5.1% FY2025, ten-year average 5.9% against Pool 12.1% and Home Depot 14.2%. Against it, recorded: gross margin up 3.5 points and held through deflation, pre-tax return on tangible capital about 19% (about 12% with goodwill). Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash $182.3M all-equity, $181.3M equity-only (FY2021 to FY2025 average); a serial acquirer (purchases 0.87 times owner cash before purchases), central case on the organic pair at 2.64% a year; net debt $565.6M at the June 2026 seasonal peak; range **$61.63 to $79.02 a share** all-equity (equity-only $74.15 to $91.44) against $87.99, no case earns the floor (4.1% to 5.1%); fair **$32.93** all-equity, $45.62 equity-only, $38.34 at the year-end net debt of $329.6M; not armed. Ten balance sheets read: equity $149M to $1,659M, goodwill and acquired intangibles $750M (45% of equity); debt flat near $385M through the 2020 share issue of $261.7M; fleet finance leases $135M and branch leases $460M outside the debt line; bad-debt allowance $4.7M to $33.3M (about 6% of gross receivables). After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: annual guidance on Adjusted EBITDA, featured ahead of the audited figures; the 2023 to 2025 performance shares paid 0% on a 5.7% three-year earnings decline; every buyback at an average $99 to $141, above every case, under an authorization naming no price. Contamination declared by the analyst: git status folder names (AYI, ARCB), the Siemens commit subjects, memory lines on queue state; none names SITE; nothing used. Commits 5ef1e24d, 9a4c29fc, a4b810ae, b1ea3ab2. Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_quote_check.py`) found 29 fragments, none unmatched, every id in the ledger, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) no rule for charging assets acquired on finance leases in owner cash (a CONVENTION of this run, $4M to $35M a year here); (2) net debt at the latest balance-sheet date takes a seasonal distributor's June peak, moving fair by $5.41 a share; (3) the organic pair's "organic growth as the filer reports it" includes price and names no years; (4) at Q2 for a roll-up, returns with and without goodwill point different ways (about 12% and 19% pre-tax); (5) no rule for the competitor row when every named rival is private or a subsidiary; (6) whether the convention on a row about one company covers a row about a class of business. Could not get: a full landscape cycle in the public record (listed 2016); the rivals' landscape lines; FY2016 to FY2022 statements are XBRL transcription, spot-checked; fleet spending before 2019 uses lease principal as a stand-in.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: the largest national wholesale distributor of landscape supplies, a roll-up whose own Item 1A calls barriers to entry generally low; local and regional rivals still 81% of the market, Home Depot entered by buying SRS (Heritage), prices follow commodity costs both ways, cost to serve up with scale, operating margin 4.5% FY2016 and 5.1% FY2025 (ten-year average 5.9% against Pool 12.1%, Home Depot 14.2%); Q1 IN. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range $61.63 to $79.02 a share all-equity (organic pair, a serial acquirer) against $87.99, no case earns the floor (best 5.1%); fair $32.93 all-equity ($45.62 equity-only), not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: guidance on featured Adjusted EBITDA; buybacks at $99 to $141, above every case.
